messages:
priya: Heads-up: ACME legal escalated — they want per-tenant retention tiers + BYOK before pilot kickoff. Need acceptance criteria, quick cost delta for Q2 planning, and risk notes for sales. cc @kevin @elaine @nate
kevin: clarifying q — do they require full-text searchable logs for entire retention, or is export-only acceptable after 90d? any concrete SLA asks?
priya: they said searchable for 90d, exportable up to 3y. SLA language was "near-immediate" for 90d searches; we should propose numbers.
elaine: ops constraints: exports + legal-hold need a documented runbook and per-tenant retention toggle. BYOK implies escrow/legal proof for decrypt. Also regional residency flags for specific tenants.
nate: rough infra delta: warm index (90d) about $8k/mo for ~5TB; cold-archive + restore pipeline ~$4k/mo; ops overhead ~$1k/mo. One-time eng effort ~2-3 eng-weeks for export/playbook + BYOK handshake flow.
miguel: field asks: documented evidence export API and a chain-of-custody manifest. Suggested payload example:
curl -X POST "https://console.redwood.ai/v1/admin/exports" -H 'Authorization: Bearer <token>' -H 'Content-Type: application/json' -d '{"tenant":"acme-corp","from":"2023-01-01","to":"2023-12-31","format":"zip","include_kms_proof":true}'
miguel: propose soft-degrade SLA tiers: 90d searchable 99.5% <30s; 90-365d limited quick-export (sampled index) restore ~4h; >365d cold ZIP export restore 24-72h. Balances cost vs enterprise needs.
kevin: technical risks: BYOK handshake (escrow + rotation), per-tenant indexing costs, and cross-region discovery/privacy when combining datasets. Decision required: self-serve retention tiers or enterprise-gated?
priya: my proposal:
1) Acceptance criteria: BYOK handshake docs + test harness; per-tenant retention tiers (90/365/3y); export API + manifest; legal-hold toggle; regional residency flag.
2) SLAs: 90d search 99.5% <30s; exports 4h for <365d, 48h for >365d (cold).
3) Prioritization: P1 for enterprise pilot customers; P2 for self-serve in two quarters.
4) Owners: eng-security (kevin) for BYOK; eng-ops (elaine) for export/playbook; product (priya) for acceptance docs.
compliance-bot: Reminder: attach SOC2 control mapping and audit evidence list to the ticket before pilot start.
priya: I'll capture this in the roadmap and draft a short PRD with acceptance criteria + cost delta. Nate: can you add the infra numbers to the shared sheet? Kevin/elaine/miguel please flag blockers by EOD. :white_check_mark:
